description.value:
Tool Manipulation — Innate Technique (6th level)

  • The cost to create a Floating Tool becomes 1 CE

  • When you command a Floating Tool, they can move up to 40 feet

  • You gain a flying speed of 60 feet by mounting a Floating Tool

  • You can have 2 Floating Tools active at the same time, commanding both as part of the same action.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Toggle the fly effect while mounted. 2 tools at once; move 40 ft.

effects.name: Riding a Floating Tool (toggle)
effects.description: Conditional bonus: enable this effect while its condition applies.
